title: Observer design for classes of nonlinear port-Hamiltonian systems
summary: This paper presents a systematic observer design methodology for a class of port-Hamiltonian (pH) systems with state-dependent input matrices. Such systems can model a wide range of electromechanical systems, including magnetic levitation systems, MEMS devices, and electro-active polymer actuators such as DEA actuators, HASEL actuators, etc. In these applications, state-dependent input matrices naturally arise when the system is modeled under quasi-static electrical assumptions.
